exp-003: RRF Aggregation of Contamination Detection Signals.

Fuses per-item signal scores from exp-002 into composite exposure scores
using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (Cormack et al., 2009).

Input:  Signal JSONs from /root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals/{model}_{dosage}_{seed}/
Output: Per-item exposure scores in [0,1] for downstream IRT calibration (exp-006)

CSV output columns: item_id, benchmark, model_id, model_size, dose, seed,
                    rrf_score, rrf_raw, s1_embedding, s2_minkpp,
                    s4_selfcritique, rank_s1_embedding, ...
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import logging
import re
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

SIGNAL_KEYS = ["s1_embedding", "s2_minkpp", "s4_selfcritique"]
SIGNAL_NAMES = {
    "s1_embedding": "Embedding",
    "s2_minkpp": "Min-K++",
    "s4_selfcritique": "Self-Critique",
}
DEFAULT_K = 60

SIGNAL_ROOT = "/root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals"
LABELS_ROOT = "/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/sft_data"
BENCHMARKS = ["mmlu", "gsm8k", "arc_challenge"]
DOSAGES = ["d000", "d005", "d025", "d100"]
DOSAGE_NUM = {"d000": 0, "d005": 5, "d025": 25, "d100": 100}

SKIP_PATTERNS = ["DEPRECATED"]

# D076: alpha=16 / lr=2e-4 checkpoints — all downstream signals invalidated
ALPHA16_BLOCKLIST = {
    "Qwen2.5-3B_d000_s42",
    "Qwen2.5-3B_d000_v2_s42",
    "Qwen2.5-3B_d005_s42",
    "Qwen2.5-3B_d025_s42",
    "Qwen2.5-3B_d100_s42",
}

_DIR_RE = re.compile(r'Qwen2\.5-(\d+\.?\d*B)_(d\d+)(?:_[va]\d+)*_(s\d+)')


def parse_model_dir(dirname: str) -> dict:
    """Parse signal directory name into model_size, dose, seed."""
    m = _DIR_RE.match(dirname)
    if not m:
        return {"model_size": "unknown", "dose": "unknown", "seed": "unknown"}
    return {"model_size": m.group(1), "dose": m.group(2), "seed": m.group(3)}
